markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set holds Invasive only, but the second model disagrees on the top class.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1% | Strong lead |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / OOD 1.0 | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Disagrees on top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive [F5] | Mostly supportive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce benign stroma/fat** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Benign tissue scant; concept model links absence to invasive · Validated
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 0, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; association only, not counted figures · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 2, 5) · ↑ invasive · Scored well above typical in several regions · Unreliable
- **Marked pleomorphism** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Above typical, but near-zero contribution in concept model · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion vs random 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown faithful; leans on Unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Second model (MUSK) picks a different top class, so 99% may be overconfident.
- Input is a degraded simulated frozen section; reliability AUROC only 0.69 (CI 0.58 to 0.87).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 5** — Confirm necrosis is real tumor necrosis, not artifact; spot check 3/20.
2. **Regions 0, 2, 10** — Count mitoses yourself; concept spot check was 0/20.
3. **Regions 3, 7, 11** — Lateral margin suggested tumor-involved [F7]; region 11 has the lowest invasive risk.
